name: Town Crier
ability: Each night*, you learn if a Minion nominated today.
interaction: Storyteller nods (yes) or shakes head (no) for whether any Minion nominated during the previous day. No choice is made.
drunk_or_poisoned: May be given the wrong yes/no (misinformation), routed through the central inform mechanism.

rulings.text: Learns only yes/no: not which players or how many Minions nominated.
Example: four players nominate, two of them Minions, nobody executed: Town Crier learns 'yes'.
A Minion nominating a Traveller for exile does not count (exiles are not affected by abilities): Town Crier learns 'no'.

Marker resets to 'Minions not nominated' at dawn; swapped to 'Minion nominated' when a Minion nominates. If unsure, the Storyteller may wake Minions with 'Did you nominate today?' and they must answer honestly.

test_scenarios.name: minion nominated
test_scenarios.setup: Alice Town Crier, Bob Poisoner, Carol Imp, Dan Chef, Eve Empath.
test_scenarios.actions: Day 1: Bob nominates Dan; Carol nominates nobody. Night 2.

test_scenarios.name: only demon nominated
test_scenarios.setup: Alice Town Crier, Bob Poisoner, Carol Imp, Dan Chef.
test_scenarios.actions: Day 1: Carol (Demon) and Dan nominate; Bob does not. Night 2.
test_scenarios.expected: Alice learns no; the Demon is not a Minion.

test_scenarios.name: traveller exile ignored
test_scenarios.setup: Alice Town Crier, Bob Baron (Minion), Tom Scapegoat traveller.
test_scenarios.actions: Day 1: Bob calls for Tom's exile; no other nominations. Night 2.

test_scenarios.name: poisoned gets wrong answer
test_scenarios.setup: Alice Town Crier, Bob Poisoner, Carol Imp.
test_scenarios.actions: Night 1: Bob poisons Alice. Day 1: Bob nominates. Night 2 (Alice still poisoned).
test_scenarios.expected: Storyteller may tell Alice no (misinformation); truthful yes also legal.
